versions.changelog:
community-group-buying-acquisition-retention v1.0.0

- Initial release focusing exclusively on user acquisition and retention for community group buying.
- Covers full-chain knowledge and operating procedures: acquisition channel matrix, community management framework/SOPs, user value segmentation, repeat purchase drivers, and platform-specific strategies.
- Includes hands-on tools like a user segmentation analyzer (Python).
- Excludes product selection (Module 1) and group leader operations (Module 2) to maintain clear module boundaries.
- Suitable for platform operators and group leader managers.
